ei.title: How AI Machines Learn and Improve
ei.subject: 11월_2022 고1 모의고사
ei.lesson: How AI Machines Learn and Improve

fullPassage: You may have seen headlines in the news about some of the things machines powered by artificial intelligence can do. However, if you were to consider all the tasks that AI-powered machines could actually perform, it would be quite mind-blowing! One of the key features of artificial intelligence is that it enables machines to learn new things, rather than requiring programming specific to new tasks. Therefore, the core difference between computers of the future and those of the past is that future computers will be able to learn and self-improve. In the near future, smart virtual assistants will know more about you than your closest friends and family members do. Can you imagine how that might change our lives? These kinds of changes are exactly why it is so important to recognize the implications that new technologies will have for our world.

questions.passage: You may have seen headlines in the news about some of the things machines ①<u>powered</u> by artificial intelligence can do. Therefore, the core difference between computers of the future and ④<u>those</u> of the past is that future computers will be able to learn and self-improve. In the near future, smart virtual assistants will know more about you than your closest friends and family members do. Can you imagine how that might change our lives? These kinds of changes are exactly why it is so important to recognize the implications that new technologies will have for our world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: rather than 뒤에는 동명사(V-ing)가 와야 하므로 require → requiring
det.analysis:
❌ ① powered - 'machines (which are) powered by AI'로 명사를 꾸미는 과거분사. 적절
❌ ② that - 'the tasks that machines could perform'의 목적격 관계대명사. 적절
✅ ③ require - 'rather than' 뒤에는 앞의 to learn과 형태를 맞춰 동명사 requiring이 와야 함. require는 틀림 ←정답
❌ ④ those - 'computers of the past'를 대신하는 지시대명사(복수). 적절
det.tip: rather than + V-ing → requiring

These kinds of changes are exactly why it is so important ④<u>recognizing</u> the implications that new technologies will have for our world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 가주어 it ~ 진주어 to부정사 구문이므로 recognizing → to recognize
det.analysis:
❌ ① enables - 'it enables machines to learn'에서 주어 it에 맞춘 동사. 적절
❌ ② those - 'computers of the past'를 대신하는 지시대명사. 적절
❌ ③ how - 'imagine how that might change'의 간접의문문을 이끄는 의문사. 적절
✅ ④ recognizing - 'it is so important to recognize'로, 가주어 it의 진주어는 to부정사여야 함. recognizing은 틀림 ←정답
det.tip: it is important + to부정사 → to recognize

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 가정법 'if you were to ~' 구문에서는 주어와 상관없이 were를 쓰므로 was → were
det.analysis:
❌ ① powered - AI로 구동되는 기계를 꾸미는 과거분사. 적절
✅ ② was - 'if you were to consider'는 미래의 일을 가정하는 표현으로, 주어가 you라도 항상 were를 씀. was는 틀림 ←정답
❌ ③ those - 과거의 컴퓨터를 대신하는 지시대명사. 적절
❌ ④ why - 'the reason why'처럼 이유를 나타내는 관계부사. 적절
det.tip: if + 주어 + were to + 동사원형 (가정법 미래)

det.korean: minor(사소한)는 key(핵심적인)와 반대. AI의 '핵심' 특징이 학습이라는 맥락에 부적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① headlines - 뉴스 표제. 원문 적절
❌ ② perform - 기계가 과업을 수행하다. 원문 적절
✅ ③ minor - 원문 key. AI의 '핵심적인' 특징이 학습 능력이라는 맥락이라 minor(사소한)는 부적절 ←정답
❌ ④ future - 미래의 컴퓨터. 원문 적절
det.tip: key features(핵심 특징) vs minor(사소한)

❌ ④ important - 함의 인식이 중요하다. 원문 적절
det.tip: will know more about you(당신을 더 잘 안다) vs forget(잊다)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

❌ ② care less for you: 덜 신경 쓴다는 부정적 의미로 문맥 부적합
❌ ③ replace all of you: 대체한다는 내용은 본문에 없음
❌ ④ hide facts from you: 숨긴다는 내용은 본문에 없음
det.tip: assistants will ______ than your closest friends do → know more about you

det.korean: 그것(AI)은 기계가 새로운 것을 배울 수 있게 해준다
det.analysis: 핵심 동사 enables(가능하게 하다)로 시작해요. 'A가 B하게 해주다'는 enable A to B 구조라서, 주어 it → enables → 대상 machines → to learn → 목적어 new things 순서로 배열해요.
det.tip: enable + 목적어 + to부정사 → it enables machines to learn new things
